sentences.text: [deadpan, dry humor] The fastest gun in the West had one rule: never draw first.
Noon. Slow Eddie just nods and says, after you.
You grab your gun faster than ever... and hit the dirt.
See, choosing to move makes your brain decide first. Reacting skips that.
Niels Bohr tested it with toy guns, and reportedly never lost.
But in twenty ten, scientists found the head start still wins.
So drawing second makes you faster... [pause] and still dead.
Tomorrow: dropped in ancient Rome with just a phone.
